levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن المبارك

notes: «رواه يحيى بن سعيد عن حنظلة بن قيس ورفعه» names a different transmitter for the same saying: variant group, not a route
«كما رواه مالك عن ربيعة» names another route for the same saying: variant group
The main route is the chain ending at Rafi' b. Khadij (Companion), who is the speaker of the ruling
